notes.title: New Year's Event 2024 - competition
notes.notes:
From tomorrow Dec. 29, 2024 - 12:00 noon a competition for puzzle lovers begins.

[list]
[*] The first three places will receive a prize from Parker.
[*] All participants will receive a unique New Year's Eve tattoo for the Simkea character
[*] Each participant can play multiple times and thus improve the score if fewer shifts are needed.
[*] End of participation and the game will be Jan. 01, 2025 12:00am.
[/list]

Have fun and a bit of luck is also needed 8)

Also big thanks to Parker for the loving support of Simkea.<3

notes.title: Herbstfest 2022 - Halloween
notes.notes: Jedes Jahr gibt es bei Simkea spezielle Ereignisse zu Halloween. Kürbisschnitzen, Geisterjagt mit echtem Gewinnen und Pilze sammeln sind nur einige der diesjährigen Highlights. Steigt ein in ein Sonderling der Spiele!
